INVALID-DATE-REJECTED/F1.why: Malformed dates parse to a value instead of NaN; test/shared.test.js (in both vitest projects, so it runs once per project) fails by assertion in all three runs.

INVALID-DATE-REJECTED/F2.why: checkIn stops validating its date; the InvalidDateError assertions in shared.test.js fail in all three runs.

CURRENT-STREAK-TODAY-OR-YESTERDAY/F1.why: A streak ending yesterday counts as 0; test/streaks/streak.test.js (project 'streaks') fails by assertion in all three runs.

CURRENT-STREAK-TODAY-OR-YESTERDAY/F2.why: 'Yesterday' becomes two days ago; streak assertions fail in all three runs.

FREEZE-BRIDGES-ONE-GAP/F1.why: A freeze bridges a gap with no check-in before it; streak assertions fail in all three runs.

FREEZE-BRIDGES-ONE-GAP/F2.why: Every missing day is bridged; streak assertions fail in all three runs.

FREEZE-BRIDGES-ONE-GAP/F3.why: The bridge checks the frozen day instead of the day before; assertions fail in all three runs.

WEEKLY-PERCENT-ROUNDED/F1.why: Percentages truncate instead of rounding half up; test/weekly/weekly.test.js (project 'weekly') fails by assertion in all three runs.

WEEKLY-PERCENT-ROUNDED/F2.why: Sunday is never counted; assertions fail in all three runs.

WEEKLY-PERCENT-ROUNDED/F3.why: The week starts on the given date instead of its Monday; assertions fail in all three runs.

FREEZE-NOT-A-CHECKIN/F1.why: shared.test.js never freezes a day that already has a check-in (partial on R4: no ConflictError check): green 3/3. Control (tracker.js unparseable) fails to load, so it executes the module. Whole suite 3/3: no test fails in every run.

FREEZE-NOT-A-CHECKIN/F2.why: A freeze recorded as a check-in passes the declared shared.test.js 3/3; test/streaks/streak.test.js and test/weekly/weekly.test.js fail in all three runs and are not declared for this claim.
